items.title: Clem Raymond Interview, 1958-08-25
items.q: Yeah. Raymond Burke has one like that,

ctx.x: Why didn't I see that? Yeah. The minus giants in that. It doesn't come apart yet. Keep it all in one long piece. Yeah, the case is like a violin case.
Yeah. Raymond Burke has one like that,
both an A and a B-flat, all in one piece. Big long case.
